d: "When wild animals start invading homes, backyards and places where people least expect them, Turtleman gets the call! From snakes slipping into unwanted spaces to raccoons, mink and other troublesome creatures causing chaos, these encounters put people in need of help. Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, teams up with Neal James to handle unusual wildlife rescue and removal missions, catching animals that have become a problem for local residents.
